title: Marlengine scene file
description: A scene: its entities and their components. Generated from the component registry; see docs/scene-format.md. The engine's loader is the authority.

$schema.description: The path or URL of this schema, for editors; the engine ignores it.

entity.description: A named thing in the scene, made of components.

name.description: Unique within the scene. 1 to 64 characters, no control characters, no leading or trailing whitespace, no '/'. Other entities refer to this one by this name.

components.description: The entity's components, keyed by component name.

component_Transform.description: Where an entity is, how it is turned and how big it is.

position.description: World position [x, y], in world units.

rotation.description: Turn about the position, in radians, counter-clockwise.

component_SpriteRenderer.description: Draws the entity as a quad at its Transform: a flat color, a texture, or one cell of a sprite sheet.

texture.description: Image path relative to the working directory; empty draws a flat color. An asset file path, relative to the working directory, written with '/' and without '..'.

cell.description: Sprite sheet cell [column, row], row 0 at the bottom.

cellSize.description: One sprite sheet cell [width, height] in pixels; [0, 0] uses the whole texture.

tint.description: Color [r, g, b, a], each 0 to 1, multiplied with the texture.

component_Camera.description: Views the scene from the entity's Transform.

zoom.description: How much to magnify the view; larger shows less of the world.

primary.description: Whether the scene is drawn through this camera.
